title: Israeli forces raid Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City
body:
On 15 November 2023, Israeli forces raided Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City, the largest medical complex in the Gaza Strip, after days of heavy fighting in the surrounding area. The Israeli military said early on Wednesday that it was conducting an operation against Hamas in a specified area, and said the raid was based on Israeli and US intelligence. Israel has said Hamas runs a command centre beneath the hospital and uses tunnels to hold hostages, which Hamas denies.

Health officials said about 650 patients, including 22 in intensive care and 36 premature babies, were inside, along with about 400 medical staff and more than 2,000 displaced people. Another doctor, Ahmed El Mokhallalati, put the figures at about 700 patients and more than 1,000 trapped medical staff. Al Jazeera reported that about 30 people were taken to the courtyard, stripped and interrogated, a claim attributed to witnesses and not independently verified.

Palestinian Authority Health Minister Mai al-Kaila called the raid a crime against humanity. UN aid chief Martin Griffiths said he was appalled, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said reports were deeply concerning, and the International Committee of the Red Cross said it was extremely concerned. The White House said the US had information that Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad used hospitals for military purposes. Human Rights Watch said Israel had provided no evidence justifying the loss of hospitals' special protection. Al Jazeera reported that Israel's five-week bombardment had killed more than 11,200 Palestinians, a figure attributed to Gaza authorities.
